item.title: P500 pay hike for kasambahays in BARMM okayed
item.description: TACURONG CITY (MindaNews / 18 December) – Kasambahays or domestic workers in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) will receive a monthly increase of P500 starting this month, officials said. item.title: Detour road
item.description: Backhoes from the Department of Public Works and Highways work overtime on Thursday (18 December 2025) to build the temporary road that will allow heavy trucks to pass through the zigzag road in Sitio Kipolot, Barangay Palacapao in the municipality of Quezon, Bukidnon. item.description: DAVAO CITY (MindaNews / 18 December) – Durian exports to China decreased to only 5 million kilos this year from 35 million kilos last year, representing a drop of 85.7% an exporter based in Davao City said. item.title: Christmas in Naawan
item.description: The newish municipal hall of Naawan in Misamis Oriental gets spruced up for Christmas with a giant Christmas tree and its honeycomb façade brightened up with colored lights. Photographed Thursday evening (18 December 2025) by BOBBY TIMONERA / MindaNews
